title: Three improvements, zero gain -- the constancy is the finding

the_evidence.change: coverage bug fixed (93 never-attempted tasks now labelled)
typing fidelity fixed; empty-library refusal became NOT_LOOKED
loop reversed to SEARCH-THEN-PLAN; plan produced 1 -> 9 tasks

why_it_did_not_move.planner_is_not_the_bottleneck: r86 produced a plan for 9 tasks (up from 1) and only 2 won
the_binder_is: enter-password : 'Enter the password "0xMq" into BOTH text fields'
enter-text-2   : 'Type "leonie" in ALL UPPER CASE letters'
why_it_did_not_move.mechanism: the executor binds ONE literal into ONE control; those goals need two literals, two fields, or a transform

taxonomy.I_2: dynamics must be inferred from action-response

literature_match.finding: frontier models struggle especially on I_2; the paper's answer is a finer action interface (cursor move separated from mouse-down and mouse-up) that yields an observation before committing
literature_match.mapping: the 92 no-literal tasks are I_1/I_2; the 8 arity>1/transform tasks are pure binder failures and are the cheapest remaining gain

honest_statement: The suite did not move for three rounds of real fixes. Continuing to tune the planner is the wrong move. The binder is the bottleneck and it is small enough to fix.
